title: Single source of truth for steps (StepsRepository stream)
goal: Fix tester bug: walking tab steps don't match Home; step count slow and inaccurate
steps: Create one StepsRepository exposing a stream of today's steps (Health Connect when permitted, pedometer fallback)
Refactor Home steps card AND walking tab to read from this single stream — no independent listeners
Reduce update latency to max 2 seconds after sensor or Health Connect event
acceptance: Home and walking tab always show the identical number within 2 seconds
No duplicate step counting after app restart
